purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only min/max limits on one caller-selected world-space x or y relative offset while preserving slack motion inside the interval and free orthogonal translation.

properties.limits: bounded explicit x/y world-axis limits with minOffset and/or maxOffset
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: slack motion inside the allowed interval is intentionally free
axis does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
standalone v0.1.0 is not yet integrated into the shared composer/activity/isolation stack
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: slack motion inside the allowed interval

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly a translation-only world-axis range primitive and is not relabeled as a full prismatic joint.

agency.basis: Callers choose axis, min/max bounds, activity state and bounded solver factors/iterations.

continuity.basis: The donor core remains untouched and the primitive is additive beside existing locks and distance limits.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The first version stays standalone so mixed-stack integration can be tested explicitly without accidentally advancing donor physics twice.
